name: OhMyWitch!
source:
It is the first year I have had the chance to join the Halloween parade. BUT WHY THE MONSTER KIDNAPPED ME TO THE OTHER WORLD?! And this charming monster wants me to be his Witch. What do you think I should do?!

On the other hand, I also met the cat I lost. But why did he suddenly become a human?! 

Let's meet these charming boys in the Isekai!

[From [url=https://rice-love-coffee.itch.io/ohmywitch]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是我第一次有机会参加万圣节游行。但为什么怪物要把我绑架到另一个世界？！这个迷人的怪物想要我成为他的女巫。你觉得我该怎么办？！

另一方面，我也遇见了我失去的那只猫。可是他怎么突然变成了人类？！

让我们在异世界遇见这些迷人的男孩吧！

[来自[url=https://rice-love-coffee.itch.io/ohmywitch]itch.io[/url]]
